title: Darwin's dog that inherited a fear of butchers

tellings.quote: the case that Darwin was reported in a paper in nature was a dog that belonged to someone he knew that got very frightened whenever it went past a butcher's shop

plain: Charles Darwin, the naturalist, is said to have reported a dog, belonging to someone he knew, that got very frightened every time it walked past a butcher's shop, as if it had inherited the fear. The scientist Rupert Sheldrake tells this case and says it appeared in a paper in Nature, the science journal, though he gives no date or further detail. He brings it up because, if true, it would suggest that fears and memories can pass down from one generation to the next.
